dialogue_texts: Yukari
Seriously, first Koakuma throws a tantrum about the Grieg twins...
Yukari
And now I find myself in the Kozankyo Cemetery...
Yukari
This entire venue feels intentionally separated from reality.
Separated?
Oh, I'd say the boundaries are simply expanding to make room for a grander performance.
The vampires love a good display, after all.
Welcome to the quietest corner of Kozankyo, My Majesty.
Doromi
I am Doromi Akatsuki - the most prim dhampir you'll ever meet.
Yukari
A dhampir playing an architect in a parallel world. How fascinating. I must admit...
Yukari
Stitching the roots of the Order into the soil of this cemetery is a clever way to mask the spiritual bleed.
Doromi
Oh? You recognized the structural alignment instantly. As expected of a Sage.
Doromi
The Order wants its vengeance, but I simply require a lively venue to test the structural limits.
Yukari
A flawless experiment requires a controlled environment, my dear.
Yukari
But by fracturing this space, you are stepping directly onto my canvas.
Yukari
You're making a mess of Marisa's autumn equinox festival.
Doromi
Let it crumble! A temporary festival is nothing compared to the twilight of the Order.
Doromi
Out here, where the veil between worlds is as thin as my inheritance...
Doromi
Do you truly think your boundaries can withstand a multi-layered reality?
Yukari
You speak of the veil as if you discovered it. I am the veil.
Yukari
If you wish to test the boundaries of this parallel world...
Yukari
Let us see how much pressure your fragile twilight can take before it shatters entirely!
Doromi
Fascinating. Let us see if your light can pierce the eternal shroud!
